subject: Close trajectory recast, MAP adjustments & credit ask
messages:
From: Andrew Li <andrew.li@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Cho <elena@kestrelhealth.com>, Kestrel Health Procurement <procurement@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & go-live window — potential slip (impact to acceptance)

Kimberly —

Quick note after this morning's acceptance run: the eval team hit a blocker with the patient-data ingestion test that will push our internal verification by ~10 business days unless we carve out engineering assistance. That slippage cascades the overall go-live and may push our contract acceptance past the Nov 15 window.

Given the procurement deadlines and board reporting cycles, we need to understand:
- Can Redwood commit a short-term run of dedicated support (pairing with our SRE) to recover ~5 of the 10 days?
- If not, what concessions (credits, fee relief, extended test windows) can be provided to cover the acceptance shift?

We'd like a written recast of the MAP and suggested next steps by Wednesday so we can present to the steering committee.

Thanks,
Andrew
Senior PM, Kestrel Health

Attachment: error_log_1027.txt (see referenced stack traces in line 4-18)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Li <andrew.li@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Kestrel Health Procurement <procurement@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & go-live window — potential slip (impact to acceptance)

Andrew — thanks for flagging and for the log snippet. I'm sorry the ingestion test surfaced this — I know the Nov 15 acceptance target is important.

High level proposal:
1) Immediate: dedicated pair-of-eyes from Redwood platform SREs — 4 engineer-hours/day for 5 business days (to run root-cause, temporary workaround, and a targeted retest).
2) If we can recover those 5 days, we propose a formal MAP recast that re-anchors remaining milestones (UAT sign-off, security attestation, procurement sign-off). Draft attached: Kestrel_MAP_v3.xlsx.
3) If recovery is not achievable within that window, Redwood will extend the acceptance window by 10 business days and provide a one-time account credit equivalent to 10% of first-quarter usage to offset the operational impact.

Next steps: please confirm asap if you want the SRE pairing (we can start tomorrow morning). If you want the extended window + credit, we'll prepare an SOW amendment and an executive note for approvals.

I'll also loop in our contracts lead internally to speed up the SOW amendment.

—Kimberly
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Kestrel_MAP_v3.xlsx (proposed timetable), SOW_amendment_draft.pdf (template)

Team — forwarding a customer escalation. Key facts:
- Kestrel ingestion test discovered a blocker; they estimate a 10 business day slip.
- We can likely recover ~5 days with SRE pairing (they asked to start tomorrow).
- Request: 10 business day extension OR one-time 10% Q1 credit if we cannot fully recover.

Ask: Can we greenlight the SRE pairing right away? Also need approval to offer the 10% one-time credit (if recovery fails) and to fast-track an SOW amendment template for signature.

I attached the draft MAP and SOW. If we proceed with pairing I will confirm start time and provide a short runbook.

SLO/contract context: acceptance window currently Nov 15 -> procurement has board deadlines end of Nov. Any credit or extension will need legal sign-off but I'd like Rishi/ Priyom to OK commercial term in principle so we can respond to the customer with a single play.

Thanks — Kimberly

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kestrel Health Procurement <procurement@kestrelhealth.com>, Elena Cho <elena@kestrelhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP & go-live window — potential slip (impact to acceptance)

Andrew — thanks again for the log. Quick update and formal offer:

1) SRE pairing: our SRE team will begin remote pairing tomorrow (Thu 10/21) at 09:00 PT. They will run focused diagnostics and a targeted rerun of the ingestion path; estimated support 4 engineer-hours/day for up to 5 business days.
2) MAP recast: attached is the updated timetable (Kestrel_MAP_v3.xlsx) that compresses remaining verification into a two-week window assuming SRE pairing proceeds and no new blockers arise.
3) Contingency (credit + extension): if the pairing doesn't resolve the issue and acceptance shifts beyond the new anchor, Redwood will provide a one-time credit equal to 10% of anticipated Q1 usage and extend the formal acceptance window by 10 business days. We will route this via an SOW amendment for signature; draft attached (SOW_amendment_draft.pdf).

Please confirm acceptance of the SRE pairing and whether Kestrel wants us to route the SOW amendment now or only if the workaround doesn't close the gap. We'll standby for procurement's preference — if you want the amendment pre-signed we will draft with Legal priority routing.

I'll also send a short exec summary for your steering committee and a single-thread status doc for internal tracking.

Best,
Kimberly
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
